name: io.github.bobpanil/vivatlas
title: VIVATLAS
description: Self-hosted catalogue of your skills, agents and MCP servers, searchable by meaning over MCP

environmentVariables.name: SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Signs sessions and encrypts stored tokens. Set once and keep it; left empty, the container generates one and keeps it in /data.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Gemini key for the descriptions, search embeddings and picture choice. Optional; Ollama works too (OLLAMA_URL). Also settable in the admin panel.
